description: Get the SEC Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 "baby shelf" capacity: how much the issuer may raise off an effective shelf now, under the one-third-of-public-float cap that applies below a $75M non-affiliate float, less trailing-twelve-month takedowns. Returns the float basis, the cap, takedowns counted and the remaining raisable amount. 🔴 `constraintApplies: false`: the cap does NOT bind (float >= $75M, primary offerings unlimited under I.B.1); not "no capacity" and not a favourable finding. 🔴 `constraintApplies: null` with `suppressedReason: "float_unmeasured"`: the float value was NOT MEASURED; report not measured, NEVER as "the cap does not bind" and NEVER as unlimited. 🔴 A `suppressed` figure is WITHHELD (e.g. an issuer delisted to OTC cannot run an S-3 primary): report it as not stateable, NEVER as $0 raisable. `suppressedReason: "ib6_pool_unattributed"`: the cap applies but trailing sales could not all be attributed, so $0 is a lower bound; `remainingCapacity` is null and `capacityUpperBoundDollars` means "at most". `suppressedReason: "issuer_not_ib6_limited"`: the issuer's current prospectus offers more than the cap with no I.B.6 limitation (`issuerUnlimitedOffer`); whether the cap applies is NOT MEASURED, never $0, constrained or unlimited. `floatValueBasis: "issuer_stated"`: the issuer's own printed I.B.6 float (`issuerStatedFloat`, prospectus <= 60 days old) was lower than the live valuation and was used. A null remaining capacity is not measured, not zero. ALWAYS RETURNS 200: read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED; it never means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check: decide from the availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted, never published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_baby_shelf_capacity
title: Get Baby-Shelf (S-3 I.B.6) Raisable Capacity
